### 2026-10-27: So Week 4 started and again i am using Requiem

**1.78h**

So Week 4 started and again i am using Requiem
my project is RequiemQuest a small retro 2d console using Raspberry Pi Pico as main controller

So i started with creating new project in KiCad Added Pi Pico In Schematic then added 5 SW_Push Buttons its going to be lot simpler than RequiemXT , 5 Buttons will be UP,DOWN,LEFT,RIGHT and ACTION then i added a Conn_01x06 ( Our Screen Connector).

### 2026-10-29: So I Finally found it what i need to make it little more complicated so i am going to make RequiemQuest Portable for that we need battery so i will be adding A Lithium Battery Charger and Power Switch

**1.92h**

So I Finally found it what i need to make it little more complicated so i am going to make RequiemQuest Portable for that we need battery so i will be adding A Lithium Battery Charger and Power Switching Circuit.

Then i after looking around little about what to use i added a TP4056 (Standard 8-pin battery charger IC) then a SW_SPDT( Power Switch ) and a Conn_01x02_Pin (Battery Connector) then R (Charge Current Resistor), then 2  10uF Filter Capacitors  To keep the power smooth and stable, Lastly A 1N5817 Power Selector Diode ( I don't even know what does it do though).
